cliPath.description: Path to the openclaw binary used for the Judge call and the push. Default 'openclaw' (resolved from PATH).

dbPath.description: SQLite registry path. Default <openclaw state dir>/goal.db.

defaultMaxTurns.description: Default turn budget for a new goal. Default 20.

dryRun.description: When true, log what would be pushed but do not push. Default false.

enabledAgents.description: Optional allowlist of agent ids this plugin acts on. When empty, all agents are covered.

judgeModel.description: Model for the Judge (one-shot call). Default openai/gpt-6.1-sol. The free deepseek model is monthly-limit-exhausted until ~Dec 3, 2026.

judgeTimeoutMs.description: Judge call timeout in ms. Default 120000. The Judge is a model call on a loaded VM (~60-70s); the agent_end hook is fire-and-forget, so the Judge may run longer than the ~30s hook budget.

maxJudgeOutages.description: Consecutive judge outages before the goal pauses. Default 3.

maxParseFailures.description: Consecutive unparseable judge outputs before the goal pauses. Default 3.

maxStalledTurns.description: Consecutive no-progress turns before the goal pauses. Default 5.

pushTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for the push agentTurn. Default 300.

reflectorEnabled.description: When true (default), wait/complete are recorded as pending requests and validated by the agent's reflector session instead of applying immediately / the one-shot judge.

pushRoute.description: Push route shared with the goal plugin: 'api' (default) or 'cli'. Only the goal plugin pushes; this keeps the tool-side config in step.

verdictTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a reflector evaluation may run before the one-shot judge fallback resolves it. Default 300.

description: The goal tool: the agent declares its session goal, reads it back, and completes it (audited by the Judge).
name: Goal Tool
